description: This file defines the 'SpaceshipBinary' class, which extends 'AbstractBinary' and represents the spaceship operator ('<=>') in Twig's expression binary nodes.

classes.name: SpaceshipBinary
classes.description: Represents the spaceship (spaceship operator) in Twig's expression syntax tree, generating the '<=>' operator in compiled PHP.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Generates the raw PHP code for the spaceship operator ('<=>') in the compiled template.
